messages:
maria (platform): quick question — our prefetch window for the embeddings route is currently a fixed 120ms. noticing some tenants with spiky small requests are seeing higher per-token cost because prefetch pulls full kvcache and triggers larger batches. can we discuss making the window tenant-configurable or adaptive?

ajay (eng): yeah i noticed that too. the problem is small frequent 1-3 doc requests end up queued until the window flushes which increases latency and also inflates batch sizes for downstream sharder.

kevin (devex): i think product will push back if latency jumps. can we offer a console toggle: "adaptive prefetch" with a per-tenant target latency vs cost slider? simplest UX: on/off + sample rate for telemetry.

lucy (product): +1 for a simple toggle. customers care about predictable p50. Option: set default off for free-tier, on for paid tiers. provide visible metric: prefetch_fill_rate and prefetch_latency_impact.

sam (sre): main SRE concerns: backpressure when the adaptive algo ups the window for throughput bursts — we need clear circuit-breakers. also tie into quota circuit so prefetch doesn't allocate beyond reserved capacity.

ajay (eng): proposing two changes: (1) make the prefetch window adaptive based on recent request inter-arrival distribution (exponentially-weighted) and (2) add a per-tenant soft-token budget that prefetch can consume but counts against quota. if exceed => degrade to immediate pass-through.

maria (platform): sketch of config shape i was thinking for console (this will be stored per-tenant):

```
{
  "prefetch": {
    "mode": "adaptive",          // static | adaptive | off
    "min_window_ms": 10,
    "max_window_ms": 250,
    "target_latency_ms": 50,
    "quota_budget_units": 1000   // soft units charged per prefetch
  }
}
```

kevin (devex): looks good. for UX we should show a projected delta: estimated tokens/month increase if enabled. we can compute from batch_fill_rate and avg_seq_len. add an "estimate" preview before user flips toggle.

lucy (product): also show rollback button and a canary rollout option in console (percent of traffic). customers want quick revert.

sam (sre): telemetry we need emitted: prefetch_attempt, prefetch_granted, prefetch_rejected_quota, prefetch_hit, prefetch_miss, prefetch_eviction. make them high-cardinality friendly (aggregate by tenant id + route).

ajay (eng): agreed. i propose the metric names and the labels: route, tenant_id, window_ms, batch_size. Also add internal gauge batch_fill_ratio.

maria (platform): implementation notes: runtime will need a fast path to mark requests eligible for prefetch so routing can prefer warm lanes. KV cache fill should be async and bounded by the tenant soft budget. if budget low -> mark as "no-prefetch" and surface reason in response header `x-prefetch-reason`.

kevin (devex): can we surface that header in SDKs too? devs will want to instrument. maybe map to a binary event in our client telemetry so they see how often prefetch is blocked.

ajay (eng): implementation caveats: when prefetch triggers and the batcher coalesces, we occasionally hit 413 on the ingress if payload framing unexpectedly grows (rare but happened in prod test). need a guard that prefetch only merges if projected payload < route_max_payload.

sam (sre): operational playbook: if we see sudden spike in prefetch_rejected_quota across tenants + increased 5xx, auto-roll back adaptive mode globally and notify SRE channel. also add synthetic probe hitting route with small qps to measure p50 baseline.

maria (platform): rollout plan: feature flag behind ff-prefetch-adaptive. Start with internal tenants + 5 pilot customers. Metric goals: p50 should not degrade > +10ms, cost delta < 8% for pilot. collect 2 weeks of telemetry.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for ff-prefetch-adaptive -> waves: internal->pilot-5->progressive 20/50/100.

kevin (devex): docs todo: write console doc explaining "prefetch budget" units, how to interpret estimates, and examples (low-latency chat vs high-throughput vectorize). add a short snippet for SDK showing how to read `x-prefetch-reason`.

lucy (product): ok next steps: ajay implement runtime guard + metrics; kevin add console UX mock + estimate calc; sam write playbook; maria wire up flag + pilot onboarding email. i'll own rollout gating.

maria (platform): thanks all — i'll update the internal RFC and attach the console mock. tagging @kevin and @ajay to sync tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
